text: The M05 settings table at 2.1.8 gates three Agent-card elements on `agent.disableDirectFilesystemAccess` being off: Allowed paths, Disallowed paths and Always excluded. The build now hides Allowed and Disallowed paths while the box is ticked (src/client/chat/settings/agentSettings.tsx). It keeps `Always excluded` always visible. The element has no `visible` predicate, its caption says 'This cannot be turned off', and u08's e2e expects it visible by default. The artifact deny-set also stays in force whatever the flag says: `artifactDenyDirs` is always non-empty, and agent-turn always emits the ALWAYS-DISALLOWED line. Hiding a rule that is always enforced would mislead the user, so the code keeps it visible. Hiding Disallowed paths raises a similar question. `agent.disallowedPaths` still feeds the turn's path scope (`resolvedPathScope.userDisallowedPaths` and the sandbox's `disallowedPaths`) while the built-ins are blocked, so a user cannot see or edit an exclusion that still applies. Suggestion: in the M05 table, state that `Always excluded` is shown whatever the flag says. Then either confirm that Disallowed paths should hide with the flag, or keep it always shown, which was the behaviour since 0.2.113, if `disallowedPaths` still binds a blocked agent.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0012 — Always excluded stays visible regardless of agent.disableDirectFilesystemAccess; Allowed/Disallowed paths hide while it is on.
